## Two-Handed Melee
Two-handed melee weapons are slower to swing but deal significantly more damage. They require both hands to use, meaning you cannot hold a firearm at the same time - but in melee range, their power is unmatched.
## Spears
Spears are versatile two-handed weapons with reach. They can be thrown and deal good damage against armored and unarmored targets alike.
[bold]Wasteland Spear[/bold]
Notes: Basic reaching weapon. Can be thrown.
[bold]Tribal Spear[/bold]
Notes: Decorated tribal construction. Similar stats to the Wasteland Spear.
[bold]Flag Spear[/bold]
Notes: Spear with faction banner. Ceremonial but fully combat-capable.
## Hammers & Sledges
Blunt force weapons that crush through armor. The Super Sledge is the pinnacle of two-handed blunt weaponry.
[bold]Sledgehammer[/bold]
Notes: Heavy blunt weapon. Good damage against armored targets.
[bold]Super Sledge[/bold]
Notes: Pre-war hydraulic sledge. Exceptional damage. Rare and prized.
[bold]Tribal War Club[/bold]
Notes: Large blunt club. Slower swing, heavy impact.
[bold]Nail Board[/bold]
Notes: Improvised spiked club. Common Wasteland weapon.
## Long Blades
Large swords and blades for those who prefer cutting over crushing. Many are tribal or ceremonial in origin.
[bold]Longsword[/bold]
Notes: Standard two-handed blade. Balanced reach and damage.
[bold]Tribal Sword[/bold]
Notes: Handcrafted long blade. Rougher edge than manufactured swords.
[bold]Tribal Machete[/bold]
Notes: Oversized two-handed cutting blade.
[bold]Ripper[/bold]
Notes: Motorized blade weapon. Pre-war construction. Very high damage.
